title: Candidate ranking evaluation infra: NDCG/MRR telemetry + customer promptset integration
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a production-ready evaluation and telemetry pipeline for candidate-ranking (reranker) that captures NDCG and MRR at both offline and online slices, supports customer-provided prompt sets, and exposes A/B testing hooks. Goals: 1) standardize per-request ranking telemetry with latency and token-cost breakdowns, 2) ingest customer prompt sets for deterministic replay and ground-truth labelling, 3) add A/B experiment signals so we can attribute ranker changes to NDCG/MRR delta and latency/cost trade-offs, and 4) make the infra scale to 100k ranked requests/day with minimal extra cost. This ticket covers schema design, insertion into the observability pipeline (metrics/logs/traces), dashboard queries, and a lightweight eval harness for quick offline regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Per-request ranking telemetry emitted: candidate_ids, scores, final_order, query_embedding_id, reranker_model_version, token_count, generation_latency_ms, serve_latency_ms
Batch job that computes daily NDCG@5 and MRR@10 across global and customer promptset slices and writes results to metrics DB
Support upload and registration of customer promptsets (CSV/JSON) in console with metadata: customer_id, promptset_id, label_schema
A/B experiment hook: routing key appended to request, and results can be joined with experiment cohort to compute deltas
Dashboards: time-series for NDCG/MRR trends, per-customer promptset breakdown, and latency vs quality scatter plot
End-to-end test: run a seeded offline eval using a customer promptset and reproduce expected NDCG/MRR numbers in CI
Documentation: Confluence runbook for onboarding customer promptsets and interpreting metrics
tasks: Design telemetry schema (logs + metrics + trace annotations) and proposal doc
Add telemetry emitters to reranker service (Go) with sampling knobs and structured JSON payload
Implement upload endpoint and DB table for customer promptsets; include validation and schema mapping
Offline eval harness: KD-tree candidate selection -> reranker scoring -> compute NDCG/MRR -> save artifacts
Instrument A/B cohort tag propagation through gateway to reranker and to telemetry events
Create daily aggregation job (Airflow) to compute slice-level NDCG/MRR and push to metrics DB
Build Grafana dashboard and SQL views for per-customer promptset analysis
Load test telemetry pipeline end-to-end at 2x expected peak and validate retention/ingest costs
Write CI test that runs small eval on PRs changing reranker scoring code
notes: Telemetry schema must be compact to avoid high egress costs; consider protobuf for internal stream and JSON only for archived logs
We should reuse existing embedding ids (from ENG-4721 family) to link query embeddings with ranking telemetry
Prior work: ENG-9342 provides rerank evaluation instrumentation baseline; this ticket expands to customer prompt ingestion and A/B hooks
Potential optimization: compute NDCG sketches incrementally in the aggregator to avoid full window scans
Privacy: customer prompt uploads may contain PII; ensure upload flow triggers DLP and KMS tagging as part of Private deployments
